notes.title: 🎉 1000 wishlists! Thank you for your support!
notes.notes:
A huge thank you to everyone who added Vampire Cat to their wishlist and provided feedback during the [b]Creature Collection[/b] and [b]Zombie vs. Vampire[/b] festivals. Your feedback motivates me enormously, and I'm preparing some big changes for the sequel, which will arrive a little later:

[list]
[*] The wheel will now spin [b]infinitely[/b]
[*] You will be able to control [b]3 cats[/b] at the same time
[*] Each cat will have a [b]unique ability[/b] to defeat enemies
[*] [b]Bosses[/b] will challenge your runs
[*] Cats will no longer be unlocked automatically... you will have to [b]purchase[/b] them
[*] With each CashOut, [b]the wheel will change shape[/b]
[*]
[/list]

I'm continuing to work on other features and new features. Thanks again.

notes.title: Vampire Cat reveals its true nature
notes.notes:
Hello to all you night creature hunters!

I've decided to change the name of the game from "Vampire Spin" to "Vampire Cat." Why? Because this new name better reflects what the game really is: a strategic 2D roguelike where you capture, upgrade, and battle with vampiric cats.

The word "Spin" referred to a central mechanic of the game, but it could be confused with casino games, which isn't the goal here. Vampire Cat is clearer, more impactful, and above all... much more cutely evil 😼🦇

Nothing changes in terms of gameplay: you'll still be able to capture your creatures, plan your attacks, and evolve your army of fang-twisted felines.

Thank you for your support.

[img]https://media1.tenor.com/m/5VsfbTyb2uoAAAAC/oddkast-funny.gif[/img]
